rules.statement: Submit every field of the schema (`limitation` null when there is none) and no other, as valid JSON. `views` has at least one entry; each `view` is Downgrade pressure, Stable, Upgrade potential or Not assessable, `category` and `confidence` take only their listed values, and every view lists at least one `evidence` citation with its `source_id`, `locator` and `quote`.

Give exactly one view for each agency in `register.agencies` of the module context, its `agency` written exactly, and none for another agency or twice. If the ratings source's register or trigger terms cannot be read, the step is refused as `Rating register not found` or `Trigger terms not found`.
No view's `confidence`, and not `overall.confidence`, is High, because forward headroom rests on analyst-assumed drivers.

Every `rationale` and gap field is nonblank prose with no bare figure (digits only inside a period or filing label); a figure appears only as `{ref|unit}` with a `ref` and `unit` listed in the module context (`cp1_facts`, the `triggers` thresholds or the `cp2g` rows), closed and non-empty, and never a reference to a value that is not settled. A `limitation` is plain text: no figure and no reference. Write no peer ranking, instrument recommendation or recovery conclusion, no rating call (`will be downgraded`, `will be upgraded`, `will downgrade`, `will upgrade`, `is certain to be`, `our rating`, `we rate`, `shadow rating`, `implied rating`) and no probability weighting (`probability-weighted`, `expected value` and similar).
Cite each quote verbatim under the locator of its page in the ratings source; a quote not on that page is refused.
A `Stale input` issue means a bound CP-2G or CP-1 input changed after the context was read; no edit to the submission cures it.
